subject.title: Feature: Inject post-install/update system event into active session

question: Should ClawHub install/update automatically notify an active OpenClaw session, or should the inspectable copy-prompt flow remain the supported setup handoff?
rationale: The requested behavior would move publisher-controlled skill instructions into active agent context, which changes consent, trust, and session-targeting boundaries that source inspection cannot decide.

options.title: Design consent-aware handoff
options.body: Approve a narrow session handoff contract with explicit user consent, target authentication, failure behavior, docs, and tests before implementation.

options.title: Keep copy-prompt boundary
options.body: Keep the current inspectable prompt flow as the supported setup path and document that CLI install/update does not drive active sessions.

recommendation.title: Design consent-aware handoff
recommendation.body: Approve a narrow session handoff contract with explicit user consent, target authentication, failure behavior, docs, and tests before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick is tied to the current CLI/prompt surface in blame and is the collaborator who said the idea should be prioritized.
